string-array.name: privacy_bodies
string-array.item: This app is published by UK DEVELOPERS. This policy explains what information the app handles, why, and what control you have over it. By installing and using the app you agree to this policy.

You do not need to create an account to use this app. We do not ask for and do not collect your name, email address, phone number, date of birth, photographs, contacts, calendar, microphone input, camera input, or precise GPS location. We do not sell your personal information.

Like most mobile apps, some information is gathered automatically by the services the app uses: 

• Usage and device analytics — general events such as app opens and screens viewed, plus device model, Android version, language and country. Collected via Google Firebase Analytics. 
• Crash diagnostics — if the app crashes, a technical report (stack trace, device model, Android version) is sent so the fault can be fixed. Collected via Firebase Crashlytics. 
• Advertising identifier — a resettable device advertising ID used to serve and measure ads. 
• Notification token — an anonymous push token so new-story notifications can reach your device. 
• Install count — the app records that an installation occurred, so we can see overall install numbers. This is not tied to your identity.

The following stays on your phone and is never uploaded by us: 

• How many times you have opened the app. 
• Your chosen reading font and text size. 
• Which stories you have marked as favourite or already read. 
• Stories and audio you download for offline use, saved in the app private storage area. 
• A record of your membership purchase (the Google Play purchase token, the validity period and the purchase date) so the app can tell whether your membership is still active. 

All of this is removed when you uninstall the app or clear its data.

Free use of the app is supported by advertising, provided by Google AdMob and Meta (Facebook) Audience Network. These partners may use your resettable advertising ID and general device information to select and measure ads. They may show personalised ads where permitted. \n\nYou can limit this at any time in Android under Settings, then Privacy, then Ads, where you can reset or delete your advertising ID and opt out of ad personalisation. An active VIP membership removes ads from the app.

VIP memberships are sold and processed entirely by Google Play Billing. We never see or store your card number, bank details or billing address — Google handles payment. The app only stores the purchase token and validity dates on your device so it can unlock member features and detect expiry.
If you allow notifications, the app can alert you about newly added stories. You can turn notifications off at any time in your Android system settings for this app, without affecting anything else.

• Internet, network state and Wi-Fi state — to load stories, audio and ads. 
• Notifications — to tell you about new stories. Optional. 
• Foreground service and media playback — so audio stories keep playing when you leave the app, with controls in your notification shade. 
• Storage — to save stories and audio you choose to download. 
• Vibrate — for notification feedback. 
• Billing and advertising ID — for memberships and ads, as described above.

The app relies on these providers, each of which has its own privacy policy that governs the data it receives: 

• Google Firebase (Analytics, Crashlytics, Cloud Messaging, Realtime Database, Firestore, Storage) 
• Google AdMob 
• Google Play Billing and Google Play Services 
• Meta Audience Network 

We recommend reading their policies to understand how they process data.

Analytics and crash data are retained by the relevant provider according to that provider policy, and are used only in aggregate to understand app stability and usage. Everything the app stores locally is deleted when you uninstall the app or clear its data from Android settings. If you would like us to remove any information associated with your device from our systems, email us using the address below and we will act on it.

Content is fetched over encrypted HTTPS connections. Your membership record is kept in the app private storage area, which other apps cannot read. No system is perfectly secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security, but we take reasonable steps to protect your information.

We may update this policy as the app changes or as legal requirements change. The revised policy will appear on this screen with a new date at the top. Continuing to use the app after an update means you accept the revised policy.
Questions, concerns or requests about privacy are welcome. Email us at ukdevelopers007@gmail.com and we will respond as soon as we reasonably can.

Some categories and audio stories require a VIP membership. Memberships are one-time purchases valid for a fixed period which is shown to you before you pay. When the validity period ends, member features stop automatically and you are not charged again; buy another membership if you wish to continue. Prices are set in your Google Play account currency and may change for future purchases.

Nothing in these terms limits any liability that cannot lawfully be limited, and nothing removes consumer rights you have under the law of your country.
We may restrict or end your access to the app if you breach these terms, misuse the service, or attempt to defraud the payment system. You may stop using the app at any time by uninstalling it.
